description.value:
You fire a spray of 4d6 tiny projectiles, divided as you choose among up to four creatures you can see within range. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1 kinetic damage per projectile aimed at it, or half as much on a success.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, you fire an additional 1d6 projectiles and can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
